raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Support `--dwdp-size` on Ascend NPU using the existing GPU DWDP algorithm: keep each rank's tokens local and prefetch peer expert weights into two reusable local buffer slots.

GPU implementation reference: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/29778

## Modifications

- Add an ACL VMM backend with resident local expert shards, preferring FABRIC handles and falling back to ACL IPC only for a confirmed single-host launch. All ranks agree on the route; PID authorization remains enabled. ACL forbids re-exporting one physical allocation, so route detection uses a disposable probe, not the real weights.
- Reuse the original CUDA layer collector, page layout, fixed-size `PagePool`, prefix/local/suffix mapping, per-expert parameter gathering, remote expert-slice copy loop and double-buffer stream/event protocol. Keep CUDA's search scope, support predicates and operation ordering unchanged.
- Keep only platform-specific allocation, ND migration, handle export/import, raw-pointer Tensor construction and resource release in the NPU backend. Every forward copies all remote expert slices, including boundary bytes; resident local experts are not recopied.
- Accept loaded BF16/FP16 unquantized and W8A8 INT8 NPU MoE kernel/layout families. Gather per-expert scales, offsets and biases during initialization.
- Select the backend lazily, without importing CUDA transport on NPU. Preserve existing user/model shared-expert settings, common offload/memory-saver policies and graph configuration precedence. No model-specific, Attention, ordinary EP, DeepEP or FuseEP changes are included.
- Keep this PR production-only: remove both newly added test files from the final diff. Preserve the existing upstream GPU DWDP tests unchanged. The removed suite is retained locally for validation, not committed or registered in CI by this PR.
- Build each layer's peer ranges and remote slices in the existing binding pass, avoiding a separate traversal and duplicate range construction. Keep the runtime copy/event/slot protocol unchanged.
- Preserve stepwise imported-memory release bookkeeping so retries do not repeat successful unmap/address-release operations.

## Validation of this revision

Revision: `fe830622abef6736651b5ce96cb5893325946cce` (2026-10-19).

Validation uses the **locally retained suite**, which is not included in this PR. The copy test fixture was adjusted for the removed private initialization helper; real-device cases still run the complete manager setup and MoE forward path.

- **80 CPU checks passed** with Ascend Python packages hidden.
- **92 checks passed in the two-NPU invocation**, including **12 real MoE cases**, on physical devices 14/15 of `113.46.15.88` (301.81 s).
- All real device cases selected **ACL IPC**. Successful FABRIC import/map/copy and cross-host execution remain **unverified on hardware**.
- **144** kernel/dtype/layout/topology combinations preserve the previous acceptance set.
- Repository-pinned Ruff/isort, original-CUDA discovery/mapping/gather comparisons and `git diff --check` passed. All **13 production files** match the archived validation snapshot by Git blob hash.

No test file, test registration or test-running command is added by this PR. Existing upstream GPU tests remain unchanged.

Real-device coverage: BF16/FP16/INT8 × small/large weights × automatic/forced-IPC routing; ND/NZ source weights, mixed widths, decoder-indexed MoE layers separated by dense layers, remote-buffer poisoning and restoration, exact local-shard preservation, cross-layer page reuse, reference-output parity and unequal forward counts (2 versus 5). CPU tests cover FABRIC ABI/route agreement, cross-host IPC refusal, migration failures, event ordering, fixed-page reuse and partial-release retries.

No model server, new GSM8K run, performance benchmark or graph capture/replay test was started for this cleanup. No new GPU hardware run is claimed.

## Historical model accuracy

These are **earlier measurements, not a full-model validation of this head**. Model: `Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8`; host: `113.46.15.88`; CANN 9.1.0, torch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post6. Same 200 GSM8K examples, 5-shot completion prompts, concurrency 8, temperature 0, top_p 1, max output 512 tokens; flush before evaluation.

| Mode | Correct / 200 | Accuracy | Failed | Length-limited | Evaluation time |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| TP8 + attention DP8, EP1 | 184 | 92% | 0 | 0 | 111.05 s |
| Ordinary EP8 + attention DP8, separate EP fixes | 186 | 93% | 0 | 0 | 105.78 s |
| DWDP8 + attention DP8 | 186 | 93% | 0 | 6 | 1041.80 s |

Collected on 2026-10-06 before the shared Tensor-copy refactor. The ordinary EP row requires experimental routing/combine fixes **outside this PR**. The current DWDP-only checkout is validated at the real-MoE/operator level, not by an additional full-model serving rerun. DWDP's per-step weight prefetch makes integrated decode substantially slower; the intended use is a disaggregated **prefill** worker.

## Historical prefill performance

Same earlier checkout and model. 128 total requests, 8192 input tokens/request, 1 output token/request; **client/server concurrency 8, not 128**. Seed 1, MNT 32768, radix cache disabled. Each server runs 128 warmup requests, flushes, then measures another 128 requests; all rounds completed 128/128.

| Mode | NPUs | Input tokens/s | Duration | Mean TTFT |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| TP2 + attention DP2, EP1 | 2 | 14,896.28 | 70.39 s | 4.154 s |
| TP4 + attention DP4, EP1 | 4 | 23,895.56 | 43.88 s | 2.594 s |
| TP8 + attention DP8, EP1 | 8 | 33,027.27 | 31.75 s | 1.899 s |
| Ordinary EP8 + attention DP8, separate EP fixes | 8 | 25,380.01 | 41.32 s | 2.465 s |
| DWDP8 + attention DP8 | 8 | 73,758.27 | 14.22 s | 0.847 s |

These are single measured rounds, not repeated statistical performance claims or results for the current shared-copy implementation. Attention TP is 1; all rows use eager prefill. The prefill gain is not an end-to-end decode speedup.

### Historical DeepEP reference (DWDP disabled)

On 2026-10-08, published revision `e754adf1b06b507a9772fab5006aa7d2d083d27e`, the same eight devices `6,7,10,11,12,13,14,15`, same model/workload/concurrency. Complete 128-request warmup, then three measured rounds with a flush before each; flush again before the same 200-example GSM8K evaluation. No separate EP fixes were used.

| Existing DeepEP configuration | Input tokens/s, three rounds | Median | GSM8K |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Dispatch 512 tokens × 64 rounds, long-sequence combine | 14,454.59 / 14,604.09 / 13,871.11 | 14,454.59 | 184/200 (92%) |
| Dispatch 2048 tokens × 16 rounds, single-round combine | 24,876.21 / 25,005.84 / 25,107.09 | 25,005.84 | 182/200 (91%) |

Both completed 200/200 with no failures; length-limited responses were 0 and 2. Tuned median was 1.730× the reference. This is a DeepEP tuning reference, **not a DWDP measurement or an implementation change in this PR**. Single-round combine was validated only up to 8192 local prefill tokens/rank, not concurrency 128. Other cards on the host were not fully isolated.

## Scope and limitations

Final PR diff: **13 production files, +811/-172 (net +639)**. **No test files are included.** Relative to `fb89926aac`, this update removes 1334 lines of newly added tests and reduces production net additions from 645 to 639. The tests are backed up locally; this does not remove upstream GPU test coverage. GPU/common production files are unchanged by this update.

- FABRIC requires supported hardware, driver and topology. CANN 9.1 documents the ACL FABRIC option for Atlas A3; this PR does not claim A5 cross-host support. Same-host ACL IPC is the validated device path; real FABRIC import/map/copy and cross-host operation are still unverified.
- Existing DWDP topology restrictions remain: DWDP=TP=EP, attention DP=DWDP, MoE TP1, PP1, divisible routed-expert count. NPU supports the kernel/layout families listed above, not blanket MXFP8/MXFP4/W4/GGUF parity.
- NPU rejects LoRA and PDMux. Existing common restrictions on EPLB, speculative decoding and two-batch overlap remain unchanged. No generic shared-expert adaptation is added.
- Offload/memory-saver flags and explicit graph selectors retain their existing common policy; acceptance is **not** proof of weight pause/resume or graph capture/replay correctness. Graphs remain disabled by default.
- Imported-memory cleanup retries are tested locally. Distributed recovery after rank failure or independently retried collective cleanup is not provided.
- No Markdown, generated artifacts, model implementation or Attention backend changes are committed.

GitHub CI is not claimed fully green: the current PR gates require the maintainer-controlled `run-ci` label.

files.patch:
@@ -439,6 +439,11 @@ def handle_dwdp(server_args: Any):
         "DWDP's prefetch event protocol does not support two-batch overlap"
     )
 
+    if cfg.device == "npu":
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dwdp.manager import validate_dwdp_args
+
+        validate_dwdp_args(cfg)
+
     if cfg.disaggregation_mode == "null":
         logger.warning(
             "DWDP with --disaggregation-mode null: decode steps re-fetch all "

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+"""Ascend DWDP implementation; CUDA retains its original implementation."""

@@ -0,0 +1,269 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Ascend DWDP: resident local weights and remote-only prefetch.
+
+Only setup/cleanup use collectives. Two remote page slots are reused in layer
+order; pages intersecting a local shard remain private to that layer.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import socket
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.layer_utils import (
+    collect_moe_layers,
+    gather_per_expert_tensors,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.layout import WeightSpec, build_remote_slices
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.weight_manager import (
+    DwdpPrefetch,
+    copy_remote_expert_slices,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+from .vmm import NPUWeightVMM, _check, tensor_from_pointer
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+_WEIGHTS = ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")
+
+
+def validate_dwdp_args(cfg):
+    # Validate loaded MoE kernels/layouts in setup, not the model-wide quant label.
+    if cfg.enable_lora:
+        raise ValueError("NPU DWDP does not support LoRA")
+    if cfg.enable_pdmux:
+        raise ValueError("NPU DWDP does not support PDMux layer-split execution")
+
+
+class NPUDwdpManager(DwdpPrefetch):
+    def __init__(self, server_args):
+        import acl
+
+        self.acl = acl
+        self.nnodes = server_args.nnodes
+        parallel = get_parallel()
+        self.dwdp_size, self.dwdp_rank = parallel.dwdp_size, parallel.tp_rank
+        self.group = parallel.tp_group
+        self.device = torch.device("npu", torch.npu.current_device())
+        self._moe_layer_indices, self._position = [], {}
+        self._specs, self._weights, self._exports = {}, {}, {}
+        self._peer_views, self._peer_ranges, self._remote_slices = {}, {}, {}
+        self._vmm = None
+        self._state = "new"
+
+    def _gather(self, value):
+        values = [None] * self.dwdp_size
+        dist.all_gather_object(values, value, group=self.group.cpu_group)
+        return values
+
+    _collect_moe_layers = staticmethod(collect_moe_layers)
+
+    def _validate(self, layers):
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.quantization.moe_methods import (
+            NPUUnquantMoEMethod,
+            NPUW8A8Int8MoEMethod,
+        )
+
+        supported = {
+            NPUUnquantMoEMethod: (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16),
+            NPUW8A8Int8MoEMethod: (torch.int8,),
+        }
+        if not layers:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP requires at least one FusedMoE layer")
+        for li, layer in layers:
+            if layer.moe_ep_size != self.dwdp_size or layer.moe_tp_size != 1:
+                raise ValueError("NPU DWDP requires EP=DWDP=TP and MoE TP=1")
+            for name in _WEIGHTS:
+                kernel = type(getattr(layer, name.replace("_weight", "_kernel"), None))
+                weight = getattr(layer, name, None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(weight, torch.Tensor)
+                    or weight.device != self.device
+                    or weight.dtype not in supported.get(kernel, ())
+                    or weight.ndim != 3
+                    or weight.shape[0] * self.dwdp_size
+                    != layer.num_global_routed_experts
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"NPU DWDP layer {li}: incompatible kernel/device/dtype/shape for {name}"
+                    )
+
+    def setup(self, model):
+        if self._state == "ready":
+            return
+        if self._state != "new":
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "DWDP setup cannot be retried; clean up and reload weights"
+            )
+        layers = self._collect_moe_layers(model)
+        error = None
+        try:
+            self._validate(layers)
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            error = str(exc)
+        errors = self._gather(error)
+        if any(errors):
+            raise ValueError(f"NPU DWDP model validation failed: {errors}")
+        self._specs.clear()
+        for li, layer in layers:
+            for name in _WEIGHTS:
+                weight = getattr(layer, name)
+                count = layer.num_global_routed_experts
+                self._specs[li, name] = WeightSpec(
+                    count, tuple(weight.shape), (count, *weight.shape[1:]), weight.dtype
+                )
+        metadata = {key: vars(spec) for key, spec in self._specs.items()}
+        if any(peer != metadata for peer in self._gather(metadata)):
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP ranks have different expert weight layouts")
+        pid, ret = self.acl.rt.device_get_bare_tgid()
+        _check(ret, "device_get_bare_tgid")
+        peers = self._gather((socket.gethostname(), pid))
+        same_host = self.nnodes == 1 and len({host for host, _ in peers}) == 1
+        peer_pids = [
+            pid for rank, (_, pid) in enumerate(peers) if rank != self.dwdp_rank
+        ]
+
+        self._state = "initializing"
+        self._moe_layer_indices = [li for li, _ in layers]
+        self._position = {li: pos for pos, li in enumerate(self._moe_layer_indices)}
+        self._vmm = NPUWeightVMM(self.acl, self.device)
+        self._vmm.select_transport(peer_pids, self._gather, same_host)
+        self._init_prefetch(torch.npu, self.device)
+        local_handles = {}
+        error = None
+        try:
+            for li, layer in layers:
+                for name in _WEIGHTS:
+                    local_handles[li, name] = self._migrate_weight(
+                        (li, name), getattr(layer, name), peer_pids
+                    )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+        errors = self._gather(error)
+        if any(errors):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"NPU DWDP weight migration/export failed: {errors}")
+        self._weights = self._vmm.create_weights(
+            self._specs,
+            self.dwdp_rank,
+            local_handles,
+            {li: self._buffer_index_for_layer(li) for li in self._moe_layer_indices},
+        )
+        for li, layer in layers:
+            self._replicate_small_params(layer)
+            weights = {name: self._weights[li, name] for name in _WEIGHTS}
+            count = layer.num_global_routed_experts // self.dwdp_size
+            self._peer_ranges[li] = [
+                (rank * count, (rank + 1) * count) for rank in range(self.dwdp_size)
+            ]
+            for name, full in weights.items():
+                self._remote_slices[li, name] = build_remote_slices(
+                    full,
+                    self.dwdp_rank * count,
+                    (self.dwdp_rank + 1) * count,
+                    layer.num_global_routed_experts,
+                )
+            layer.bind_full_expert_weights(weights)
+
+        for rank, handles in enumerate(self._gather(self._exports)):
+            if rank == self.dwdp_rank:
+                continue
+            for key, handle in handles.items():
+                spec = self._specs[key]
+                page = self._vmm.layout(spec, rank)
+                ptr = self._vmm.import_shard(handle, page.mnnvl_size, page.data_offset)
+                self._peer_views[rank, *key] = tensor_from_pointer(
+                    ptr,
+                    spec.chunk_bytes,
+                    shape=spec.chunk_shape,
+                    dtype=spec.dtype,
+                    device=self.device,
+                )
+        torch.npu.synchronize(self.device)
+        dist.barrier(group=self.group.cpu_group)
+        torch.npu.empty_cache()
+        self._state = "ready"
+        logger.info(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Ascend virtual weight views with resident local pages and remote-only slots."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import logging
+import math
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.layout import PageAlignedLayout
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.page_pool import PagePool, compute_slot_sizes
+from sglang.srt.utils.alignment import align_down, align_up
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _check(ret, operation):
+    if ret != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"NPU DWDP: {operation} failed with ACL error {ret}")
+
+
+class _FabricHandleAPI:
+    """CANN V2 ABI; pyACL does not expose these APIs in all supported releases."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL("libascendcl.so")
+        for name, args in (
+            (
+                "aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2",
+                [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p],
+            ),
+            (
+                "aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2",
+                [
+                    ctypes.c_void_p,
+                    ctypes.c_int,
+                    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),
+                    ctypes.c_size_t,
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2",
+                [
+                    ctypes.c_void_p,
+                    ctypes.c_int,
+                    ctypes.c_uint64,
+                    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p),
+                ],
+            ),
+        ):
+            function = getattr(self.lib, name)
+            function.argtypes, function.restype = args, ctypes.c_int
+
+    def export_handle(self, handle, peer_pids):
+        share = ctypes.create_string_buffer(128)  # aclrtMemFabricHandle.data[128]
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2(handle, 0, 2, share),
+            "aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        pids = (ctypes.c_int32 * len(peer_pids))(*peer_pids)
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2(share, 2, pids, len(pids)),
+            "aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        return share.raw
+
+    def import_handle(self, share):
+        if len(share) != 128:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP: invalid FABRIC handle size")
+        share = ctypes.create_string_buffer(share, 128)
+        handle = ctypes.c_void_p()
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2(
+                share, 2, 0, ctypes.byref(handle)
+            ),
+            "aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        return handle.value
+
+
+def tensor_from_pointer(pointer, nbytes, *, shape, dtype, device):
+    import torch_npu
+
+    storage = torch_npu._C._construct_storage_from_data_pointer(pointer, device, nbytes)
+    stride = tuple(math.prod(shape[i + 1 :]) for i in range(len(shape)))
+    return torch_npu._C._construct_NPU_Tensor_From_Storage_And_Metadata(
+        dict(
+            size=shape,
+            stride=stride,
+            nbytes=nbytes,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            data_ptr=pointer,
+            storage_offset=0,
+            device=device,
+            npu_format=2,
+            layout=torch.strided,
+            requires_grad=False,
+        ),
+        storage,
+    )
+
+
+class NPUWeightVMM:
+    def __init__(self, acl, device):
+        self.rt = acl.rt
+        self.device = device
+        self.prop = dict(
+            handleType=0,
+            allocationType=0,
+            memAttr=4,  # ACL_HBM_MEM_HUGE
+            location=dict(type=1, id=device.index),
+            reserve=0,
+        )
+        self.granularity, ret = self.rt.mem_get_allocation_granularity(self.prop, 0)
+        _check(ret, "mem_get_allocation_granularity")
+        self._page_pool = None
+        self._handles = []
+        self._reservations = []
+        self._mappings = []
+        self._imports = []
+        self._fabric = None
+
+    def select_transport(self, peer_pids, gather, same_host):
+        # Unlike CUDA, ACL forbids exporting one physical handle twice. Probe
+        # on a disposable handle before choosing how to export real weights.
+        fabric, probe, error, cleanup_error = None, None, None, None
+        try:
+            fabric = _FabricHandleAPI()
+            probe = self._allocate(self.granularity)
+            fabric.export_handle(probe, peer_pids)
+        except (AttributeError, OSError, RuntimeError) as exc:
+            error = str(exc)
+            logger.info("DWDP FABRIC probe failed: %s", exc)
+        if probe is not None:
+            try:
+                self._release_page(probe)
+            except RuntimeError as exc:
+                cleanup_error = str(exc)
+        results = gather((error, cleanup_error))
+        if any(cleanup for _, cleanup in results):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"NPU DWDP FABRIC probe cleanup failed: {results}")
+        if all(error is None for error, _ in results):
+            self._fabric = fabric
+        elif not same_host:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"NPU DWDP across hosts requires FABRIC on every rank; "
+                f"same-host ACL IPC fallback is not available: {results}"
+            )
+        logger.info(
+            "DWDP handle exchange via %s",
+            "FABRIC" if self._fabric is not None else "ACL IPC (same host)",
+        )
+
+    def export_shard(self, handle, peer_pids):
+        if self._fabric is not None:
+            return self._fabric.export_handle(handle, peer_pids)
+        share, ret = self.rt.mem_export_to_shareable_handle(handle, 0, 0)
+        _check(ret, "mem_export_to_shareable_handle")
+        _check(
+            self.rt.mem_set_pid_to_shareable_handle(share, peer_pids),
+            "mem_set_pid_to_shareable_handle",
+        )
+        return share
+
+    def _reserve(self, size):
+        ptr, ret = self.rt.reserve_mem_address(size, 0, 0, 1)
+        _check(ret, "reserve_mem_address")
+        self._reservations.append(ptr)
+        return ptr
+
+    def _allocate(self, size):
+        handle, ret = self.rt.malloc_physical(size, self.prop, 0)
+        _check(ret, "malloc_physical")
+        self._handles.append(handle)
+        return handle
+
+    def _map(self, ptr, size, handle):
+        _check(self.rt.map_mem(ptr, size, 0, handle, 0), "map_mem")
+        self._mappings.append(ptr)
+
+    def _release_page(self, handle):
+        _check(self.rt.free_physical(handle), "free pool page")
+        self._handles.remove(handle)
+
+    def layout(self, spec, rank):
+        start, end = rank * spec.local_experts, (rank + 1) * spec.local_experts
+        size = align_up(end * spec.expert_bytes, self.granularity) - align_down(
+            start * spec.expert_bytes, self.granularity
+        )
+        return PageAlignedLayout.compute(
+            spec.expert_bytes,
+            spec.num_experts,
+            start,
+            end,
+            self.granularity,
+            size,
+            pool_granularity=PagePool.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_MULTIPLIER * self.granularity,
+        )
+
+    def create_local(self, spec, rank):
+        layout = self.layout(spec, rank)
+        handle = self._allocate(layout.mnnvl_size)
+        source = self._reserve(layout.mnnvl_size)
+        self._map(source, layout.mnnvl_size, handle)
+        return source + layout.data_offset, handle
+
+    def create_weights(self, specs, rank, handles, assignments):
+        """Map local shards and shared fixed-size pages after source migration."""
+        layouts = {}
+        for (li, name), spec in specs.items():
+            layouts.setdefault(li, {})[name] = self.layout(spec, rank)
+        self._page_pool = PagePool(
+            compute_slot_sizes(layouts, assignments),
+            self.device.index,
+            granularity=self.granularity,
+            allocate_page=self._allocate,
+            release_page=self._release_page,
+        )
+        tensors = {}
+        for li, weight_layouts in layouts.items():
+            page_offset = 0
+            for name, layout in weight_layouts.items():
+                spec = specs[li, name]
+                full = self._reserve(layout.total_size)
+                reservation = SimpleNamespace(
+                    map_existing=lambda offset, size, handle, base=full: self._map(
+                        base + offset, size, handle
+                    )
+                )
+                page_offset = self._page_pool.map_weight_pages(
+                    assignments[li], reservation, layout, handles[li, name], page_offset
+                )
+                tensors[li, name] = tensor_from_pointer(
+                    full + layout.pre_padding,
+                    spec.num_experts * spec.expert_bytes,
+                    shape=spec.full_shape,
+                    dtype=spec.dtype,
+                    device=self.device,
+                )
+        return tensors
+
+    def import_shard(self, share, size, offset):
+        if self._fabric is not None:
+            handle = self._fabric.import_handle(share)
+        else:
+            handle, ret = self.rt.mem_import_from_shareable_handle(
+                share, self.device.index
+            )
+            _check(ret, "mem_import_from_shareable_handle")
+        # Keep imported lifetimes separate: all importers must release their
+        # mappings/handles before a producer releases resident physical pages.
+        self._imports.append([handle, None, False])
+        entry = self._imports[-1]
+        ptr, ret = self.rt.reserve_mem_address(size, 0, 0, 1)
+        _check(ret, "reserve imported memory")
+        entry[1] = ptr
+        _check(self.rt.map_mem(ptr, size, 0, handle, 0), "map imported memory")
+        entry[2] = True
+        return ptr + offset
+
+    def close_imports(self):
+        while self._imports:
+            entry = self._imports[-1]
+            handle, ptr, mapped = entry
+            if mapped:
+                _check(self.rt.unmap_mem(ptr), "unmap imported memory")
+                entry[2] = False
+            if ptr is not None:
+                _check(self.rt.release_mem_address(ptr), "release imported address")
+                entry[1] = None
+            _check(self.rt.free_physical(handle), "free imported handle")
+            self._imports.pop()
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.close_imports()
+        while self._mappings:
+            _check(self.rt.unmap_mem(self._mappings[-1]), "unmap weight memory")
+            self._mappings.pop()
+        while self._reservations:
+            _check(
+                self.rt.release_mem_address(self._reservations[-1]), "release address"
+            )
+            self._reservations.pop()
+        if self._page_pool is not None:
+            self._page_pool.release()
+            self._page_pool = None
+        while self._handles:
+            _check(
+                self.rt.free_physical(self._handles[-1]), "free physical weight memory"
+            )
+            self._handles.pop()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Platform-independent DWDP layer discovery and expert parameter gathering."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+def collect_moe_layers(model):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+
+    decoder = model.model if hasattr(model, "model") else model
+    moe_layers = []
+    for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(decoder.layers):
+        experts = next((m for m in layer.modules() if isinstance(m, FusedMoE)), None)
+        if experts is not None:
+            moe_layers.append((layer_idx, experts))
+    return moe_layers
+
+
+def gather_per_expert_tensors(experts, local_experts, num_total, dwdp_size, group):
+    for name, data in experts.named_per_expert_tensors(local_experts):
+        shards = [torch.empty_like(data) for _ in range(dwdp_size)]
+        dist.all_gather(shards, data, group=group.device_group)
+        yield name, torch.cat(shards, dim=0)[:num_total].contiguous()
